market_summary: FX pairs and US100 are trapped in tight mean-reverting ranges inside their session Value Areas during the London session, respecting VWAP and EMA baselines with low volume. BTCUSD shows decisive bearish continuation, breaking below VAL and session lows along with downward CVD expansion.

signals.rationale: VP shows price is below VAL (3963.84) and below POC (3978.28). CVD is -3.27 (BEARISH) with slightly positive slope +0.28. Market is in LONDON_SESSION. Price trades well below declining VWAP (3970.67) and EMA50 (3966.70). Currently positioned mid-channel between ATR bands after bouncing off Session Low (3924.30), with forming bar stalled below EMA20 (3952.01). RVOL is low at 0.593 with no yellow spike. With price mid-channel and lack of catalyst or sweep near S/R (3968.55), hold is prudent.

VP places price inside Value Area (1.10779 - 1.10998) and below POC (1.10943). CVD is +3,376 (NEUTRAL) with negative slope (-1733.97). London session chop as price rejected off Session High (1.11027) and S/R (1.11007), falling back onto EMA20 (1.10906) and EMA50 (1.10897) just above VWAP (1.10862). Mid-channel ATR positioning and low RVOL (0.757) confirm mean-reverting chop inside the Value Area. No directional edge.

signals.rationale: VP shows price inside Value Area (1.32599 - 1.32797) and below POC (1.32738). CVD is -3,991 (BEARISH) with negative slope (-2520.54), aligning with downtrend pressure. Sitting dead mid-channel inside Value Area with no expansion or breakout volume warrants a hold.

VP shows price inside Value Area (28086.57 - 28185.57) and marginally above POC (28121.92). CVD is -3.53 (BEARISH) with negative slope (-1.47). London session context. Signal bar rejected EMA20 (28143.27) and VWAP (28132.56), closing below them, under EMA50 (28162.39). Price sits mid-channel near S/R (28100.36) without a clear break. US100 RVOL is 0.831 (typical for Dukascopy feed). Inside VA chop suggests staying aside until NY open.

VP shows price trading below VAL (73358.62) and below POC (73522.35). CVD is -0.05 (BEARISH) with negative slope (-0.01), confirming aggressive seller dominance. London session. Price broke cleanly below VWAP (73589.15) and EMA50 (73566.28), piercing the lower ATR band (73075.90) as live price pushes fresh lows at 73068.90, breaking both Session Low (73166.0) and Prev Low (73097.3). Strong momentum trend flush below Value Area supports continuation scalp.
signals.level_event: acceptance below Session Low 73166.0 and Prev Low 73097.3
